description: This file contains a seed script for populating a database with initial demo data, including users, store, products, and coupons, for an e-commerce backend using SQLAlchemy ORM.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model representing an application user with roles and status.

classes.name: UserRole
classes.description: Enumeration of user roles such as admin, vendor, and user.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Store model representing a vendor’s store with ownership and description.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Product model representing items sold in the store with prices, description, and inventory.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Coupon model representing discount coupons with codes and expiration.

methods.name: None seed_if_empty(db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the database with demo users, a store, products, and coupons if the database is empty.
